summary: STMicroelectronics N.V. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing weekly open-market repurchases under its previously announced buy-back program, first announced June 21, 2024 and approved by shareholder resolution dated May 22, 2024. A broker bought 310,000 ordinary shares (0.03% of issued capital) on Euronext Paris between September 28 and October 2, 2026 at a weighted average of EUR 47.1205, totaling EUR 14,607,365. Treasury holdings now stand at 15,583,565 shares, roughly 1.7% of issued capital, earmarked for employee share programs. Watch buy-back pace and treasury share overhang.
